topic: Electric eel: can make electric shocks of several hundred volts to stun fish and defend itself.

episode.title: Wild Superpowers: The Electric Eel’s Secret!

shots.narration: Did you know an electric eel has a shocking superpower?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D animated Amazon riverbank, leafy jungle, murky freshwater, no text.
shots.action: Kiko raises his big binoculars toward the river.
shots.mood: Sunny green foliage, curious wide eyes, inviting adventure.

shots.narration: But finding one in this murky water looks tricky.
shots.scene: Sunny jungle riverbank, Kiko safely back from the muddy water, vertical 3D nature-film composition.
shots.action: Kiko peers through his binoculars at the cloudy river.
shots.mood: Puzzled expression, warm sunlight, gentle mystery.

shots.narration: [whispers] Electric eels live in South America's freshwater.
shots.scene: Underwater Amazon river view, suspended sediment, submerged roots, one realistic cute electric eel, vertical 3D animation.
shots.action: The electric eel glides between submerged roots.
shots.mood: Soft golden underwater light, quiet discovery.

shots.narration: They also breathe air, so they visit the surface.
shots.scene: Split-level view of the jungle river surface, one electric eel beneath sunlit water, vertical 3D nature-film look.
shots.action: The electric eel lifts its mouth above the surface for air.
shots.mood: Clear surface reflections, peaceful and revealing.

shots.narration: There it is! Watching from the bank keeps us safe.
shots.scene: Wide jungle riverbank, Kiko and Pip well back from the edge, electric eel visible at the distant surface.
shots.action: Kiko points toward the surfaced electric eel.

shots.narration: [surprised] It can make electric shocks of several hundred volts!
shots.scene: Underwater close view of the electric eel, faint stylized golden pulse illustrating invisible electricity, no text or symbols.
shots.action: A soft illustrative pulse expands around the electric eel.
shots.mood: Wonder-filled golden light, exciting but gentle.

shots.narration: Those shocks can stun fish and defend the eel.
shots.scene: Murky freshwater among rounded stones and submerged roots, one electric eel, no other animals.
shots.action: The electric eel curves around a submerged root.
shots.mood: Calm, confident animal portrait with soft sunbeams.

shots.narration: Mystery solved: this hidden swimmer has real electric power!
shots.scene: Sunny jungle riverbank, Kiko standing safely away from the water, Pip hovering beside his green safari hat.
shots.mood: Broad smile, sparkling emerald feathers, cheerful discovery.

shots.narration: [excited] Which animal carries its home everywhere? Guess our next animal!
shots.scene: Bright jungle path beside the river, vertical 3D animated nature-film framing, no text.
shots.action: Kiko spreads his hands in a questioning gesture.

episode.endHook: Which animal carries its home wherever it goes? Guess next!
episode.description: Kiko and Pip discover an electric eel hiding in murky freshwater. Explore its powerful electric shocks, its surprising need for air, and a truly wild superpower!
